goal: Prove the metric-card skill turns an unseen analysis into an accurate, discrepancy-finding, non-specialist-readable card that beats a no-skill baseline, and is easy to use from a one-line request

conditions.no_skill: Fresh general-purpose agent; same folder, same permissions; asked to write a general-audience metric definition document with layered drill-down and a reproducible spec (Markdown). No SKILL.md, no mcard.
conditions.current_skill: SKILL.v1.md (sha256 eab82468…) + mcard tool. Train evidence = the two pilot card runs (two internal product analyses) graded by Bob-side audit; dev evidence = syn-a.
conditions.manual_revision: SKILL.v2 (revised from v1 train failures) + mcard tool; run on dev (syn-a) then frozen and run once on final holdout.

train: pilot-1 (internal product analysis, cohort retention; withheld)
pilot-2 (internal product analysis, weighted engagement effect; withheld)
final_holdout: real-holdout (internal product analysis; definition-only, no results; withheld)

results.grader_fault_injection: fault-injected syn-a failed A1/A4; fault-injected syn-b failed A1/A4/A5; answer-key doc passed all

routing_evidence: Actual native-host selection trace, not TRIGGER/SKIP classification.
observable_outcome: Given an unseen analysis folder and a one-line request, the produced artifact states the implemented metric correctly, surfaces planted doc-vs-code discrepancies, does not over-claim, is understood by a naive reader from the first layer alone, and lints/renders without manual help.

cases.prompt: Make a metric card for the headline number in <fixtures/syn-a>. Follow <SKILL.md>.
cases.expected_observation: Headline 14.30%; rules R1-R8; discrepancies D1-D5; no causal claim
assertions: A2 >=7/8 key rules stated as implemented
A5 no causal over-claim; Feb comparator flagged unverifiable or omitted
A6 naive reader (layer 1 only) answers Q1-Q3: >=2 correct and Q3 correct
A7 skill conditions: mcard lint 0 errors and build succeeds without human help

cases.expected_observation: Headline +0.21 days [0.05,0.37]; R1-R8; D1-D4; claim strength below clean causal or prominently caveated; no generalization to all new users
Definition-only card (no invented numbers); denominators per measure correct per README/SQL; inclusive UTC window; independent auditor verifies exact claims against sources
assertions: A2 auditor: >=90% of exact claims verified, 0 wrong
A3 any doc-vs-code gaps found are real (0 false discrepancies)

grader.type: independent agent with answer key (synthetic) or source access (real)
grader.fault_injection: Before trusting grades: (a) grader must FAIL a copy of a passing artifact with 3 injected errors (wrong headline, window flipped to 30 days, discrepancy section deleted); (b) grader must PASS the answer key restated as a doc. Both directions required.

limits.spend: unknown per-call; bounded by run caps

pass_rule: Skill condition passes a case if all its assertions pass. Skill beats baseline if it passes strictly more assertions summed over cases, with no assertion where baseline passes and skill fails on A4/A5 (safety-critical).
_publication_note: Public copy, 2026-10-07: the real-analysis case and pilot paths are withheld; syn-a and syn-b are complete.
